t: A free lesson sequence where students sketch smart homes and train a small neural network.
steps: Find the Home Automation with AI lesson page.
Read the teacher notes for both levels.
Print paper and floor plan sheets for the unplugged part.
Open MyComputerbrain in a browser and try the training yourself.
Note that training takes about 30 seconds on a 2012 laptop.
Choose the level that fits your class.
Decide whether to add the optional physical outputs.
